Host and provider metadata contracts.

## ContainerSize

Width and height measurement in CSS pixels. This shape does not perform measurement; consumers obtain host measurements from useSPFxContainerSize.

### Imports

```ts
import type { ContainerSize } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { ContainerSize } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples

```ts
import { ContainerSize } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const size: ContainerSize = { width: 720, height: 300 };
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ContainerSize.height` | `number` | Required, readonly | — | Measured container height in CSS pixels. |
| `ContainerSize.width` | `number` | Required, readonly | — | Measured container width in CSS pixels. |

## HostKind

Host discriminator returned by provider metadata. Current exported providers cover WebPart, AppCustomizer, FieldCustomizer and CommandSet; ACE is a reserved type member without an exported ACE provider.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { HostKind } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { HostKind } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { HostKind } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const kind: HostKind = 'WebPart';
```

### Type

```ts
type HostKind = | 'WebPart'
  | 'AppCustomizer'
  | 'FieldCustomizer'
  | 'CommandSet'
  | 'ACE'
```

## SPFxComponent

Union of the four supported SPFx component instances. TProps is the host properties type. Pass an initialized instance to its matching host-specific provider; access context and properties through the public React hooks rather than assuming shared public members on this union.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import type { SPFxComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples (3)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type ComponentWithTitle = SPFxComponent<{ title: string }>;
```

### Type parameters

- `TProps`: Object properties type of the supplied host instance; defaults to the empty object type.

### Type (2)

```ts
type SPFxComponent<TProps extends {} = {}> = | BaseClientSideWebPart<TProps>
  | BaseApplicationCustomizer<TProps>
  | BaseListViewCommandSet<TProps>
  | BaseFieldCustomizer<TProps>
```

### Members (3)

#### SPFxComponent branch 1

```ts
BaseClientSideWebPart<TProps>
```



## SPFxContextType

Union of the four supported SPFx host context types. Common context fields are available directly; kind is a separate metadata value and does not automatically narrow this union. When the matching provider is known, explicitly assert its native SPFx context type to access host-only APIs.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import type { SPFxContextType } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxContextType } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples (4)

```ts
import { SPFxContextType } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function webUrl(context: SPFxContextType): string {
  return context.pageContext.web.absoluteUrl;
}
```

### Type (3)

```ts
type SPFxContextType = | BaseClientSideWebPart<any>['context']
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  | BaseApplicationCustomizer<any>['context']
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  | BaseListViewCommandSet<any>['context']
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  | BaseFieldCustomizer<any>['context']
```

## SPFxContextValue

Static host metadata returned by useSPFxContext beneath a host-specific provider. Property and theme updates are exposed through dedicated runtime hooks. kind does not form a discriminated union with spfxContext; explicitly assert a known host context type for host-only fields.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { SPFxContextValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxContextValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples (5)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxContext } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function HostLabel() {
  const metadata = useSPFxContext();
  return <span>{metadata.kind}: {metadata.instanceId}</span>;
}
```

### Members (5)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxContextValue.instanceId` | `string` | Required, readonly | — | Unique identifier for this SPFx instance |
| `SPFxContextValue.kind` | `HostKind` | Required, readonly | — | Type of host component |
| `SPFxContextValue.spfxContext` | `SPFxContextType` | Required, readonly | — | Context reference of the supplied SPFx instance. Common fields are directly accessible; explicitly assert the known native host context type for host-only fields. |

## SPFxProviderProps

Shared initialized-host input contract used by the provider runtime. Prefer the host-specific provider props so TypeScript enforces the native host kind. Each mount owns an isolated runtime store and waits for ServiceScope readiness before mounting children.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { SPFxProviderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxProviderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/core';
```

### Examples (6)

#### Shared props with a real host input

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
import { SPFxProviderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function sharedProps(instance: BaseClientSideWebPart<{ title: string }>): SPFxProviderProps<{ title: string }> {
  return { instance, children: <span>Host content</span> };
}
```

### Type parameters (2)

- `TProps`: Object property bag of the supplied native host, defaulting to the empty object type.

### Type (4)

```ts
interface SPFxProviderProps<TProps extends {} = {}>
```

### Members (6)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxProviderProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional, readonly | — | Optional React subtree receiving instance metadata, runtime state and host theme. Omitted or undefined children render no application content. |
| `SPFxProviderProps.instance` | `SPFxComponent<TProps>` | Required, readonly | — | Required, initialized SPFx component instance. Use the provider matching its host type; provider descendants render after its service scope is ready. |
